title: ABS ( -2.5 ) is 2.5

source.quote: The absolute value of a number is a decimal number, whole or decimal, without its sign.
source.supports: the value without its sign; Return value: a decimal number

source.quote: The absolute value of a number with the same data type and without its sign.
source.supports: the type follows the argument, a decimal number here

derivation: -2.5 without its sign is 2.5; both pages give a decimal number for a decimal argument.
